insights.headline: Gold and silver hit one-year lows as a tech-led Wall Street selloff forced liquidation across precious metals.
points: Comex gold settled at $3,898.90, down 3.3% on the day and 10% in October; spot silver broke below $49, down about 16% in October.
The 10-year US Treasury yield fell toward 4.93% as equity losses drove bond buying, yet gold still sold off on margin calls.
Crude climbed over 2% after another Hormuz tanker attack, feeding inflation fears and expectations the Fed stays restrictive.
India's MCX followed: gold futures hit an intraday low of ₹1,41,685 per 10g; jewellers cut discounts to ₹2,000 per 10g.
Mint's Saturday wrap: MCX December gold ended October 7.9% lower at Rs 1,38,419/10g; advice — stagger Diwali purchases rather than wait for a deeper fall.
insights.summary: Spot gold sank about 3.5% to near $3,880 and silver slid 6% to below $49 on Friday, with Comex gold logging its lowest settlement since October 2025. A tech equity selloff triggered forced selling that overwhelmed support from falling Treasury yields, while another tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz and strong US data kept Fed rate-hike bets alive. MCX tracked the rout: December gold fell over 2% to ₹1,39,100 per 10 grams and silver over 4% to ₹1,81,300 per kg.

items.summary: The RBI has fixed the redemption price of Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at ₹14,167 per unit, with the exit window opening November 2, 2026, five years after issue. Investors who bought at ₹4,765 per gram in October 2021 lock in roughly 197% capital appreciation — about ₹3 lakh on a ₹1 lakh investment — plus 2.5% annual interest. The price averages IBJA 999-gold closes of Oct 28-30.
items.title: Gold bond premature redemption: SGB 2021-22 Series VII investors, here's how much you will get per unit on November 2

items.summary: Mint's bullion wrap: MCX December gold ended October 7.9% lower at Rs 1,38,419/10g (from Rs 1,50,390); spot 24K Rs 1,38,481/10g, silver Rs 1,79,527/kg. Bloomberg's spot gold $3,876.39 is a year-low and the worst October since 2008, on Iran war risk lifting crude, sticky inflation, rate bets and tech-rout margin selling. Analyst: festive buyers should buy during Diwali, in staggered purchases.
items.title: Gold rate in India today: MCX gold falls 2.5% in a week - Buy at low price or avoid ahead of Diwali, Dhanteras 2026?

items.summary: Spot gold sank about 3.5% to near $3,880 an ounce and silver slid 6% to about $49 in late US trading Friday, as a tech-led equity selloff forced investors to raise cash. Falling Treasury yields and fresh geopolitical risk from another tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz failed to cushion the fall, with higher oil prices stoking fears the Fed will stay restrictive.
items.title: Gold falls below $3,900, silver tumbles as Wall Street selloff triggers liquidation - Kitco PM Report
Silver loses more than half its value from record high: What went wrong and will it recover?
items.summary: Silver is down over 58% from its February record near $120/oz to about $50 this week, ET reports quoting Geojit's research head. Funds booked profits after a rally on solar/EV demand and tight supply; weak China/Europe industry, a strong dollar, high rates and ETF outflows deepened the slide while haven flows went to gold. $50 is key support; long-term buyers advised to wait for stabilization.

MCX December gold fell over 2% to ₹1,39,100 per 10 grams and December silver over 4% to ₹1,81,300 per kg on Friday, tracking a COMEX rout driven by Fed rate-hike bets and a tech selloff. The national average spot gold price opened at ₹1,40,891 per 10g; jewellers trimmed discounts to ₹2,000 per 10g from ₹2,500.
items.title: India Bullion: Down on rate hike fears; investors seek cash amid tech selloff

items.summary: Spot gold fell as much as 3.5% to $3,880, a level last seen in October 2025, while spot silver dropped nearly 6% to below $49 — briefly breaking $50 for the first time in nearly a year. Silver is down about 16% in October; analysts warn of further long liquidation even as the metal enters oversold territory, with the gold-silver ratio at its highest since December.
items.title: Gold price falls to one-year low, silver price down 6%

items.summary: Gold settled Friday at $3,898.90 on Comex, down 3.3% on the day and 10% for October — its lowest settlement since October 2025. MarketWatch reports analysts blame liquidity-driven selling as equity losses forced margin calls, with markets also front-running fears of US military escalation in the Persian Gulf after the midterms.
items.title: Why gold plunged to its lowest price in a year despite renewed Iran jitters

items.summary: Kitco argues gold is being punished by where investors think monetary policy is heading, not by today's lower bond yields and softer dollar. With the Fed pausing but far from finished and oil-driven inflation risks keeping rate expectations elevated, the metal's path of least resistance stays lower even as longer-term fundamentals hold.
items.title: Gold's frustrating paradox: Falling yields and a weaker dollar can't stop the selloff

items.summary: MCX December silver futures plunged ₹10,577/kg to ₹1,79,600 — below ₹1.80 lakh — while gold futures fell ₹4,347/10g to ₹1,38,249, a seven-month low, Mint reports. Silver is down 57% from its record ₹4,20,048/kg peak. Drivers: sticky US inflation (PCE 3.6% YoY), Q3 GDP of 3.4%, the Fed holding at 3.75–4% with roughly 75% December-hike odds priced, and elevated oil from the US-Israeli war on Iran.
items.title: Silver price crash deepens as Oct losses hit ₹45,000/kg; gold falls to 7-month low

items.summary: The MCX iCOMDEX Composite index held steady at 22963.67 points on Friday, Informist reports, with bullion falling while energy rose on fresh attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. The bullion component fell to 31076.28 points as of 11:05 IST; the gold sub-index eased on expectations of a December Fed rate hike, and the silver sub-index was down nearly 1% at 20842.20 points.
items.title: MCX iCOMDEX flat; bullion down while energy rises on renewed attacks in W Asia

items.summary: Silver futures on the MCX fell about 2% to an intraday low of ₹1,85,171 per kg on Friday, near ₹1.85 lakh, as the US Federal Reserve's 10-2 vote to hold rates at 3.75-4.00% strengthened bets on a December hike. December gold futures slipped 0.63% to ₹1,41,685 per 10 grams; spot gold was near $3,991 and spot silver $51.27. The slide comes just over a week before Dhanteras on November 6.
items.title: Silver futures decline to ₹1.85 lakh per kg

items.summary: Silver sank 8% on the week and fell through $50 an ounce — the metal's former all-time high from 1980 and 2011 — to an 11-month low, while gold dropped to a London low of $3,937, the cheapest since October 2025, BullionVault reports. Metals Focus says weak physical investment is still weighing on silver, and the market deficit is expected to narrow further with a surplus possible next year;...
items.title: Silver Falls Thru' 1980 and 2011 Peak at $50 as Gold Sinks

items.summary: ICICI Prudential MF CIO S Naren told the ET Wealth Expo in Mumbai that chasing gold and silver after their rallies is 'anti-asset allocation'. Silver's 216% run drew Jan ETF inflows before a 27% correction; gold's 116% gain also peaked in January. He advised buying after corrections, not momentum-chasing; central-bank demand keeps him structurally positive on gold, but avoid over-concentration.
items.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong

items.summary: The Gold & Silver Club's Lars Hansen argues gold below $4,000 is an accumulation window: the 1970s bull market fell 29% in 1973 and 46% in 1974-76 before explosive gains. He cites record $31B Q3 ETF inflows (World Gold Council) and projects a base-case gold target of $4,900-$5,000/oz by Q1 2027. Forecast attributed to source; not investment advice.
items.title: Gold Price Forecast: Buy Below $4,000 Or Risk Missing The Next Rally?

items.summary: Gold futures sank to a low of $3,933.55, last near $3,938.65 and down over 7% in October, as renewed Middle East fighting — with reports of possible US strikes on Iran after the Nov 3 midterms — keeps energy high and stagflation fears alive. Satendra Singh writes that December Fed-hike expectations are pressuring non-yielding gold, now below its 9- and 20-day moving averages.
items.title: Gold Faces Further Losses as Traders Brace for a Possible Iran Escalation

items.summary: FXEmpire's technical desk says gold fell 3.5% as traders fretted an AI bubble could burst and pressure all markets; softer yields and a firmer dollar gave no support. Gold is testing support at $3,890-$3,910, with $3,780-$3,800 next; silver dived 6% as the gold/silver ratio topped 79. Technical view attributed to source; not investment advice.
items.title: Gold (XAUUSD), Silver, Platinum Forecasts – Gold Dives 3.5% As Traders Focus On Tech Sell-Off

items.summary: Gold dipped below $4,000 — about 29% below its January record near $5,595 — yet UBS strategist Giovanni Staunovo reiterated a $5,000 target for 2027, with $5,400 by September 2027, TheStreet reports citing Reuters. The caveat: the Fed's Oct 28 hold at 3.75–4% came with two dissenters favoring an immediate hike, and higher-for-longer rates remain gold's main headwind.
items.title: Gold plunges, but UBS isn't budging on its price target

items.summary: EAM S. Jaishankar told the G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting in Atlanta that disruptions to global oil supplies through sanctions and chokepoints were a calculated strategy to hold prices hostage, warning of an energy crisis driven by unpredictability and unaffordable costs. He urged the G20 to keep energy markets open and predictable and proposed a critical minerals initiative.
items.title: Jaishankar warns of global energy supply disruptions, urges G20 action

items.summary: India's gold imports dropped 81% in September ahead of the festive season, Nikkei Asia reports, as elevated domestic prices and Prime Minister Modi's repeated appeals against buying gold choked demand in the world's second-biggest gold market. Retailers say stock on hand covers the festival and wedding seasons, leaving open whether weaker Indian demand could weigh on global bullion prices.
items.title: India's gold imports down 81%; global prices could be impacted

items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell $1.27 billion to $719.75 billion in the week ended October 23 — a seventh straight weekly decline and a more than two-month low — as the value of the RBI's gold holdings dropped $2.6 billion week-on-week to $103.1 billion, Reuters reports. Foreign currency assets rose $1.3 billion to $593.2 billion, with the decline attributed to the RBI's absorption of...
items.title: India's FX reserves dip for seventh straight week to hit over two-month low

items.summary: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price of SGB 2019-20 Series VI at ₹14,213 per unit for October 30, 2026 — about 3.7 times its ₹3,835-per-gram issue price of October 2019, Upstox reports. The price is the simple average of IBJA's 999-purity gold closes on October 27-29; the request window (Sep 29–Oct 21) has closed. SGBs pay 2.5% annual interest, semi-annually.
items.title: Sovereign Gold Bond premature redemption today: ₹3,835 investment turns into ₹14,213; check SGB 2019-20 Series VI investors' gains

items.summary: KISNA Diamond & Gold Jewellery is wooing festive buyers for Dhanteras and Diwali: 105% exchange value on old gold towards diamond jewellery, up to 100% off making charges on select jewellery, and double gold rate protection with 25% down payment. Its 'Shop Sparkle Win '26' draw across 218 cities offers 823 vehicles — 247 cars and 576 scooters — with the final draw in early December 2026.
items.title: KISNA offers 105% old-gold exchange value and 100% off making charges for Dhanteras and Diwali

items.summary: With Dhanteras on November 6, Outlook Money weighs gifting ageing parents gold versus Rs 5 lakh in cash: gold suits financially comfortable parents who value the tradition, while cash offers flexibility for hospital bills and expenses insurance may not cover. Experts advise matching the gift to the parents' savings, income and insurance cover.
items.title: Dhanteras 2026: Should You Gift Ageing Parents Gold Or Rs 5 Lakh In Cash?

trending.summary: Gold fell even as yields dropped and Iran risks rose: with equities plunging, funds sold liquid gold to cover losses. The metal is trading on where rates go next, not on today's data.
trending.title: Liquidation, not haven demand, is driving gold

trending.summary: Silver briefly broke $50 for the first time in nearly a year and is down ~16% in October, far outpacing gold's slide. Oversold signals are flashing, but analysts warn of more long liquidation.
trending.title: Silver's historic unwind deepens below $50

trending.summary: The domestic rout — MCX gold off 7.9% in October's worst month since 2008, silver deeper — lands as festive buying picks up. Analysts say stagger Diwali purchases instead of waiting for a deeper fall.
trending.title: MCX selloff lands right before Dhanteras buying

trending.summary: A 10-2 Fed vote with two dissents for a hike, plus hot oil and GDP prints, has markets pricing further tightening. Forecasters see near-term pressure even as some keep long-term bullish targets.
trending.title: Fed higher-for-longer keeps a lid on metals
